title: Availability of anthocyanins from carrot drinks in overweight and obese subjects and their effect on immune-associated vascular parameters
summary: The prevalence of obesity has risen sharply in recent years and represents a problem for society as a whole, as this condition is associated with secondary diseases such as cardiovascular disease and type II diabetes mellitus. During the disease, chronic inflammation occurs which is associated with changes in the endothelium. At the same time, the activation status of the circulating monocytes and the distribution of monocytes in the blood changes.  Based on their surface molecules CD14 and CD16, monocytes can be divided into different subtypes that vary in number and activity. In overweight and obese patients at risk, there appear to be changes in the number and distribution of these cells. It has been shown that weight reduction influences the cells and, in this context, the intake of anthocyanins (ACN) has been attributed great health-promoting and anti-inflammatory potential. The question therefore arises as to whether the regular intake of ACN positively influences inflammatory and immune-associated parameters, such as the distribution of monocyte subpopulations, in patients at risk.  Juices with a low energy and sugar content are a simple way to increase the intake of ACN in high-risk patients.  However, there is little knowledge about the bioavailability of ACN from black carrot juices in particular, as well as their fermentation and degradation, which are strongly dependent on the composition of the intestinal microbiota, which is altered in obese patients at risk (dysbiosis). In addition, the relationships between the immune-associated effects of ACN and its metabolites, the influence of the microbiome and availability in people at increased risk are unclear.

interventions.name: Verum group: intake of 60 mL carrot shot (2000 mg/L anthocyanins) per day for 28 days.
Placebo group: intake of 60 mL of placebo shot (0 mg/L anthocyanins) per day for 28 days

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
healty with BMI ≥ 27-29,9 kg/m²
Exclusion criteria:
Vegetarians, vegans, colds, allergies, taking medication, taking supplements of any kind
